sheets.prompt: Visual effect design sheet for a science fiction exploration game in ink-drawn Moebius style: a huge creature stomps and a visible shockwave rolls out across the ground, shown in four panels side by side seen from a three-quarter view above, on pale desert sand: first panel, the wind-up, the great foot raised, a thin ring of trembling grit marking how far the wave will go; second panel, the stomp lands and a ring-shaped wave of force bursts out, a curling wall of sand and air knee-high with a bright inked crest, a distortion ripple in the air above it and dust thrown up behind; third panel, the shockwave further out, a clear rolling ring of displaced sand and blasting air with speed lines, pebbles flung outward, the small traveller jumping over its crest; fourth panel, the wave fading at its full radius, a scored ring in the sand and settling dust. The shockwave is the star: a strong readable ring of force travelling along the ground, drawn with bold ink lines and a warm orange-red accent along its crest, not a flat circle. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, fine pen contours, sparse hatching, luminous flat pastel colours, cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no characters except the creature's foot and a small cloaked traveller for scale, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, lettering, labels, user interface icons, flat circle, neon.
